Guides / Hunting / Islands

Islands

The eight islands in Gym order: levels, weather, bosses, Gyms and every wild Pokémon.

Wild levelsIsland checklists1. Dewleaf Town2. Sunny Shore3. Ashen Peak4. Misty Pyre5. Frostveil Peak6. Skyhigh Cliffs7. Voltage Works8. Dragonspire

There are eight islands, opened one by one with Gym badges. Each has its own wild Pokémon, level band, weather, bosses and Gym. Fly between open islands from the Islands tab. Beat an island's Gym to open the next one.

Wild levels

A wild Pokémon's level comes from its island's band and its evolution stage: first stages sit in the lower 45% of the band, middle stages 30%–75%, final forms the top 40%, single-stage Pokémon 35%–90%. Rares are +2, and nothing is below its own evolution level (up to the band's top + 8). Legendaries come at the band's top + 4 to + 10. Before your first badge, wild levels stay within 3 of your strongest Pokémon.

Island checklists

Every island has a checklist of its own non-legendary Pokémon. Register them all and claim $5,000 × the island's number, a Master Ball, 10 Rare Candy and a Big Nugget.
